Benefits Enrolment Guide

Enrolment opens on 1 November and closes at midnight on 30 November. Elections made outside that window need a qualifying life event.

Before you start

Have these to hand. Enrolment times out after twenty minutes and does not save a partial election.

  • Your employee number
  • Dependant dates of birth
  • The plan comparison sheet, which you can download from the benefits site

Steps

  1. Sign in to the benefits portal
  2. Choose a medical plan, then a dental plan
  3. Confirm. You will get a reference of the form ENR-2026-000000 by email.

If you take no action, last year’s elections roll over, except for the health savings account, which must be re-elected every year.
